# TRAPEAK

TRAPEAK is developing a secure, user-specific data layer that is intended to make user-authorized fitness and wearable data available to MCP-compatible AI clients.

Product status: pre-launch and in development. No wearable integration is publicly available. Wahoo API access is approved and the first connection is being built. Garmin remains planned and is pending provider API approval.

## Core pages

- https://trapeak.com/ — Product overview and current development status
- https://trapeak.com/ai-guides — Index of practical AI guides

- https://trapeak.com/wahoo-mcp — Planned read-only Wahoo MCP design
- https://trapeak.com/garmin-to-chatgpt — Planned Garmin-to-ChatGPT workflow
- https://trapeak.com/garmin-to-claude — Planned Garmin-to-Claude MCP workflow
- https://trapeak.com/garmin-mcp — Planned read-only Garmin MCP design
- https://trapeak.com/wearable-mcp — Multi-wearable MCP roadmap and source status
- https://trapeak.com/privacy — Privacy policy
- https://trapeak.com/terms — Terms of service
- https://trapeak.com/data-deletion — Data-deletion information

## Important distinctions

- TRAPEAK is a data access layer, not a training dashboard or AI assistant.
- Answers and recommendations are generated by the user's chosen AI client.
- The MVP is planned as read-only.
- Third-party names and trademarks are used descriptively and do not imply endorsement, affiliation, or partnership.

Contact: support@trapeak.com
